project.name: Northwind Traders
project.description: Northwind is the classic sample trading company: it buys specialty foods from suppliers and sells them to customers worldwide. This model normalises the well-known Northwind dataset to 3NF (addresses and countries extracted) for Databricks Unity Catalog, with governance tags, a sales-region hierarchy and reporting views.

tables.name: alphabetical_list_of_products
tables.description: Active products with their category name, for catalogue listings.
tables.definition:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.supplier_id, p.category_id, c.category_name,
       p.quantity_per_unit, p.unit_price, p.units_in_stock, p.units_on_order, p.reorder_level, p.discontinued
FROM northwind.product.products p
JOIN northwind.product.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE p.discontinued = false

tables.name: current_product_list
tables.description: Products that are still sold (not discontinued).
tables.definition:
SELECT product_id, product_name
FROM northwind.product.products
WHERE discontinued = false

tables.name: customers_and_suppliers_by_city
tables.description: One list of every customer and supplier with its city, e.g. for planning regional visits.
tables.definition:
SELECT a.city, cu.company_name, cu.contact_name, 'Customers' AS relationship
FROM northwind.sales.customers cu
LEFT JOIN northwind.ref.addresses a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id
UNION ALL
SELECT a.city, s.company_name, s.contact_name, 'Suppliers'
FROM northwind.product.suppliers s
LEFT JOIN northwind.ref.addresses a ON a.address_id = s.address_id

tables.name: employee_directory_masked
tables.description: Employee directory safe for wide access: no birth date, home phone, home address or notes; last name reduced to its initial.
tables.definition:
SELECT employee_id, first_name, LEFT(last_name, 1) AS last_initial, title, extension, reports_to
FROM northwind.hr.employees

columns.name: last_initial
columns.description: First letter of the last name

tables.name: invoices
tables.description: Everything needed to print an invoice: ship-to, customer, salesperson, carrier and line values.
tables.definition:
SELECT o.ship_name, sa.street AS ship_address, sa.city AS ship_city, sa.region AS ship_region,
       sa.postal_code AS ship_postal_code, sc.country_name AS ship_country,
       o.customer_id, cu.company_name AS customer_name,
       CONCAT(e.first_name, ' ', e.last_name) AS salesperson,
       o.order_id, o.order_date, o.required_date, o.shipped_date, sh.company_name AS shipper_name,
       x.product_id, x.product_name, x.unit_price, x.quantity, x.discount, x.extended_price, o.freight
FROM northwind.sales.orders o
JOIN northwind.sales.customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN northwind.hr.employees e ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
JOIN northwind.sales.shippers sh ON sh.shipper_id = o.shipper_id
JOIN northwind.reporting.order_details_extended x ON x.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN northwind.ref.addresses sa ON sa.address_id = o.ship_address_id
LEFT JOIN northwind.ref.countries sc ON sc.country_code = sa.country_code

tables.name: mv_monthly_sales_summary
tables.description: Orders, net revenue and freight per calendar month.
tables.definition:
SELECT YEAR(o.order_date) AS order_year, MONTH(o.order_date) AS order_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
       CAST(SUM(x.extended_price) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS revenue,
       CAST(SUM(DISTINCT o.freight) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS freight_total
FROM northwind.sales.orders o
JOIN northwind.reporting.order_details_extended x ON x.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY YEAR(o.order_date), MONTH(o.order_date)

columns.name: freight_total
columns.description: Approximation: sums distinct freight values per month

tables.name: mv_sales_by_category_year
tables.description: Net sales per category and order year. Refreshed on demand or on a schedule; used by the sales dashboard.
tables.definition:
SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, YEAR(o.order_date) AS order_year,
       CAST(SUM(x.extended_price) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS category_sales, COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM northwind.reporting.order_details_extended x
JOIN northwind.sales.orders o ON o.order_id = x.order_id
JOIN northwind.product.products p ON p.product_id = x.product_id
JOIN northwind.product.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, YEAR(o.order_date)

tables.name: order_details_extended
tables.description: Order lines with product name and the extended (net) price after discount.
tables.definition:
SELECT od.order_id, od.product_id, p.product_name, od.unit_price, od.quantity, od.discount,
       CAST(ROUND(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS extended_price
FROM northwind.sales.order_details od
JOIN northwind.product.products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id

columns.name: extended_price
columns.description: unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount), rounded to 2 decimals

tables.name: order_subtotals
tables.description: Net merchandise value of every order (sum of extended prices, excluding freight).
tables.definition:
SELECT order_id, CAST(SUM(extended_price) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS subtotal
FROM northwind.reporting.order_details_extended
GROUP BY order_id

columns.name: subtotal
columns.description: Sum of extended prices of the order lines

tables.name: products_above_average_price
tables.description: Products priced higher than the average list price.
tables.definition:
SELECT product_name, unit_price
FROM northwind.product.products
WHERE unit_price > (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM northwind.product.products)
